explainer_content.short_definition: Core jazz gateway built around improvisation, harmonic language, and canon album listening.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Miles Davis, John Coltrane, Charlie Parker, Thelonious Monk, and peers map jazz from bebop language into hard bop, modal, and album-canon listening.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It teaches listeners how jazz routes operate: through players, ensembles, versions, and improvisational decisions.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The song form is often a launchpad; the route signal comes from how musicians move through it.
